prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one full-fidelity desktop homepage first-viewport design comp for Birdcar, at 1536 x 1024 pixels. A finished website interface edge to edge, no browser chrome, no physical mockup, no design-board annotations. Surface structure in reading order: (1) a slim full-width white navigation header with generous horizontal margins, the Birdcar logotype at left and actual navigation at right; (2) a spacious split hero, large left aligned statement and introductory copy occupying about 60% width, a calm assessment explanation in a simple unboxed whitespace region at right taking about 30%, (3) a fine grayblue horizontal rule introducing a restrained prose-based project proof region visible in the lower quarter of the viewport.

Direction: Classic technology consultancy. Execute the familiar technology-service consultancy standard at exceptional typographic craft, clean classic and precise, trustworthy, with Silicon Valley sophistication and personal helpfulness. This is a person helping owners of established businesses solve operating problems. Subtle glitz comes from immaculate type and light, not decoration. The website is type-led and the visitor immediately understands the promise and how to book the free assessment. No scene imagery is needed.

Palette exact: white #ffffff canvas, navy #17243a type, restrained blue #315bea controls and links, light grayblue #e9eef5 dividers or tiny supporting surface. The whole surface is mostly pure white. No gradients, textures, shadows, or dark hero.
Typography: Alkaline font ONLY for the Birdcar logo, preserving its expressive licensed brush/script character with clear letterforms. Public Sans for all main headings and body text: bold restrained grotesk headline, readable prose, clean optical sizes. Commit Mono only for short factual detail if used. NO generic display serif, no slab, no italic editorial type, no other expressive font. Logo about 48px, headline about 92px with tight but readable line spacing, body about 21px. Main title is Public Sans, not Alkaline.

Header: wordmark “Birdcar”; navigation labels “How I work”, “Selected work”, “Writing”, then a restrained text link “Book a free assessment” with simple right arrow. All in one line.

Left hero at roughly x100 y225 with exact large title broken into three balanced lines: “Make room” / “for better” / “work.” Navy Public Sans. Below it a readable 2-line introduction exactly: “I help businesses untangle work that’s become harder to keep up with.” Then a supporting paragraph exactly: “The reporting someone spends Friday assembling. The follow-up that depends on your memory. The process that keeps landing back on your desk.” Limit line width to about 630px. Beneath the copy, a solid blue rectangular CTA with softly rounded 4px corners, white label exactly “Book a free assessment”, and a simple white right arrow. Generous useful white space, sensible left alignment, no eyebrow above the headline.

Right hero: start around x1040 y330, narrow readable unboxed assessment column on the SAME pure white canvas, no surrounding card shape. A small thin blue horizontal rule can introduce the column. Heading exact “Let’s start with what’s painful.” in navy Public Sans at about 34px, three short lines. Body exact: “I’ll spend about an hour with you, then write up what I’ve understood and the improvements I recommend. The assessment is free. The report is yours to keep.” at 19px. Emphasize the final two sentences with a slightly stronger weight. This region is calm and clearly secondary to the left hero. No icons, no illustrations, no decorative labels or eyebrow text.

Lower proof beginning around y840: thin full-width grayblue rule. A modest two-column typography-only project section. Left title “Craft & Communicate” in navy Public Sans around 30px. Right prose exact: “I built a client-facing reporting platform that brings together performance data and gives the agency something it can offer its customers.” Below it a blue text link “Read about the work” with right arrow. Keep proof factual. No case study card, no fake product screenshot, no numbers, no testimonial or fake result.

Constraints: all quoted copy rendered verbatim in crisp legible text, realistic web typography and spacing, no invented brand slogans, no marketing claims, no metrics, no badges or company logos beyond Birdcar, no illustration, no stock business people, no product mockup, no grid wallpaper, no ornament, no poster composition. Build an excellent practical consultancy website with a clear booking invitation.
